args.summary: Fixed a bug in `astropy.modeling.separable.separability_matrix` where nested CompoundModels produced incorrect separability matrices. The issue was in the `_cstack` function, which handles the '&' (concatenation) operator. When the right operand was already a computed separability matrix (not a Model), the function incorrectly set all relevant entries to 1 instead of preserving the actual matrix structure. The fix changes `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1` to `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = right`, ensuring that the nested compound model's separability structure is properly preserved.
